1. Introduction 
1.1 Purpose 
This Software Requirements Specification (SRS) defines the scope, tasks, responsibilities, dependencies, and 
integration requirements for Milestone 2 of the SwipeX platform. It builds directly on the Milestone 1 increment — 
the finalized database schema,

one 1 increment — 
the finalized database schema, working Authentication/RBAC, seeded profile and job data, and the heuristic ATS stub 
— and translates the project charter's Swipe-Based Job Discovery and Smart Job Search & Filtering modules into a 
coordinated, day-wise execution plan for five interns working in parallel, so that their individual deliverables converge 
into a single, functioning system increment by the end of Day 7.

UI/search libraries are sufficient to complete everything described in this document.

3. Overall Introduction 
Milestone 2 extends the Milestone 1 foundation with the two backend services that make SwipeX feel like SwipeX: 
the Job Service (job listings, company/startup profiles, search and filtering) and the Swipe Service (record

earch and filtering) and the Swipe Service (recording 
apply/save/skip actions). Per the project charter's architecture diagram, these sit behind the same API Gateway as the 
Authentication Service, are backed by the same PostgreSQL/Redis data layer, and are consumed by the React.js 
frontend's Swipe Interface and Filters & Search components. A first version of the Matching Engine (labelled 'AI 
Recommendation Service' in the architecture diagram) is also introduced in this milestone as a rule-b

) is also introduced in this milestone as a rule-based, heuristic 
ranking layer — using profile fit and swipe history rather than a trained model — so the personalized swipe feed can 
be demonstrated end-to-end ahead of the real NLP/ML-driven recommendation and ATS-aware ranking work 
scheduled for Milestone 3. 
By the end of this milestone, a Job Seeker will be able to log in (Milestone 1), open the swipe deck, see a personalized 
feed of real seeded jobs, swipe right to apply/save or left to

seeded jobs, swipe right to apply/save or left to skip, use filters and search to narrow the catalog, and 
browse company/startup listing pages — all against live backend data running inside the shared Docker Compose 
environment.

## Sovereign On-Premise Agentic AI Workbench
### Using Open-Weight Multimodal LLMs for Confidential Industrial Work

---

## 1. Overview

An AI-powered workbench that runs entirely inside an organization's own
local network — no cloud, no internet dependency — enabling industries
with confidential data (manufacturing, pharma, defense, healthcare) to
use AI-assisted inspection, troubleshooting, and reporting without any
risk of data leaving their premises.

## 2. Problem Statement

Industries handling highly confidential data cannot use mainstream
cloud AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) because these tools transmit
user data — including images of equipment, internal documents, and
queries — to third-party servers over the internet.

This creates two blockers:
- **Data leak risk** — confidential designs, formulas, or records could
  be exposed
- **Compliance/legal risk** — many regulated industries a

pliance/legal risk** — many regulated industries are prohibited
  from sending data outside their own premises

As a result, workers in these industries are unable to access AI
assistance for tasks like equipment troubleshooting, referencing
manuals, or logging maintenance issues — despite clear potential
benefit.

---

## 3. Proposed Solution

A workbench where the AI model, document knowledge base, and all
processing run **locally**, inside the organization's own network.
Workers interact via

organization's own network.
Workers interact via mobile devices connected over local WiFi; nothing
is ever sent to the internet.

Core capabilities:
- Visual equipment inspection via phone camera
- AI-guided repair instructions overlaid on the camera feed (AR-style)
- Question-answering grounded in the company's own private manuals/SOPs
- Automatic ticket creation and escalation when needed
- A manager dashboard for oversight and trend tracking

practical value on the floor**, and **clarity of impact in a demo**.

### 6.2 Live AR Guidance
When an issue is detected, the camera view is overlaid (via HTML5

with step-by-step repair instructions shown directly on screen.

### 6.3 Local RAG over Confidential Documents

### 6.4 Agentic Actions (Ticket Creation)
Beyond just answering, the AI can take action — automatically creating
